rows.title: worker cold resumes
rows.note: 7d to 2026-10-07: 36 main-context RESUMEs (11.2M, 89%) each carry a new brief into a 60-260k context the chat chose to keep (CLAUDE.md same-session rule), cache past Claude Code's own 1h TTL; the only cheaper path, a fresh worker with a distilled brief, drops that context and cannot replay to identical decisions; 115 image-gen sidechain 5m expiries (1.4M, 11%) already gone at source (claude-setup 4f0dcd0 1h TTL, 01f7357 agent removed); worker-run's RESUME-COLD warning prints after the decision into the relay, which never forwards it, so it changes nothing

rows.title: llm-legs/test_instruction_gate
rows.note: kept (re-audit 2026-10-08): 45-52 CPU-s/run (3 runs, load 7-22, 2/3 sys = forks); a stub-gate run of the same 216 asserts costs 5.8 s, so ~88% is the gate's guarded-name slow path (220-380 ms a call, spread over ~40 forking lines, no hotspot; ordinary live calls take the 40 ms path); test-side cuts (one jq per call, 3 duplicate fast-path asserts) are ~4% and would move the harness blob shared by 7 sibling suites, re-queueing their audits; no sleeps or timeouts

rows.title: startup nested CLAUDE.md files
rows.note: real cost 0.006 % (59k limit tokens over 6 of 1881 main contexts, 7 days): Claude Code loads an out-of-cwd CLAUDE.md, in sweep repos only claude-setup/global/CLAUDE.md (3 loads, exact copy of the symlinked user file) and llm-legs worktree copies in main-cwd chats (3, exact); claudeMdExcludes could drop them but risks the symlinked user file for ~9k tokens/week; the 0.889 % is Spend scaling per-carrier averages, handed to tokenmap-waste-detectors

rows.note: 0.033 % of spend (~370k limit tokens/7 d, ~250 a firing, priced as text resent until the cut); 1469 real firings/7 d, 96 % of compact cycles clean (one stage1 + one stage2), the focus Write follows 98 % of stage1 and 92 % of stage2 nudges; the only cheaper equivalent is shorter wording, which test_context_nudge.sh pins from the manual-compact/wrap-up incident (claude-setup@03b25e0b) and no replay can prove output-equivalent, for at most ~0.013 % of spend; repeat firings (~3 %, window change or re-arm) and skipping stage2 after a fresh focus Write (176/685) change decisions; hook_success twins are not charged (tokenmap excludes their stdout)
